summary: TOCTOU in container runtime mount handling
description: The container runtime checks that a bind-mount target is not a symlink and later mounts it. A process inside the container can swap the path for a symlink between the check and the mount (time-of-check to time-of-use), escaping to the host filesystem.

summary: Proxy-Authorization header sent to another origin on redirect
description: When following a redirect to a different origin, the HTTP client library keeps the Proxy-Authorization header set by the caller, so the caller's proxy credentials are sent to the new origin.

cwes.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

summary: Session remains valid after password change
description: In this web authentication library, changing a user's password does not invalidate the user's existing sessions. An attacker who stole a session cookie keeps access after the victim changes the password. The fix revokes all other sessions when the password changes.

summary: Token expiry compared in local time instead of UTC
description: The web application's password-reset token expiry is stored in UTC but compared with the server's local time. On servers whose time zone is behind UTC, expired tokens are accepted for several hours after they should have expired, letting an attacker use a leaked reset token to take over another user's account.

summary: Coupon redeemable twice with parallel requests
description: In this e-commerce web application, a single-use coupon can be redeemed more than once by sending several checkout requests in parallel: the application checks that the coupon is unused and marks it used in two separate, non-atomic steps. Sending the requests one after the other is correctly rejected. The fix wraps the check and the update in a database transaction with a row lock.

summary: Coupon redeemable twice by resubmitting the form
description: In this e-commerce web application, a single-use coupon can be redeemed again by resubmitting the checkout form after a successful order: the application never checks whether the coupon was already used. The fix adds the missing used-coupon check.
